description: Defines a REST controller for managing 'Project' entities via CRUD operations with role-based security. It handles HTTP requests at '/api/projects' and interacts with the ProjectRepository.

classes.name: ProjectController
classes.description: Spring REST controller for 'Project' entities, providing CRUD endpoints with role-based access control.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns a list of all projects, accessible to roles 'ADMIN' and 'USER'.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new project; restricted to 'ADMIN' role.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a project by ID, available to 'ADMIN' and 'USER' roles.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing project by ID; restricted to 'ADMIN'.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a project by ID; restricted to 'ADMIN'.
